MATCH (p:Player)-[r:PlaysFor]->(t:Team)
MATCH (p)-[:ExtractedFrom]->(:Document)
MATCH (t)-[:ExtractedFrom]->(:Document)
WHERE r.tenure = 'latest'
  AND (CAST(p.nba_championships AS INT64) < 0
    OR CAST(split(p.birth_date, '/')[0] AS INT64) < 1984
    OR (CAST(split(p.birth_date, '/')[0] AS INT64) = 1984
        AND (CAST(split(p.birth_date, '/')[1] AS INT64) < 10
          OR (CAST(split(p.birth_date, '/')[1] AS INT64) = 10
              AND CAST(split(p.birth_date, '/')[2] AS INT64) <= 14))))
RETURN t.team_name AS col1, AVG(CAST(p.fiba_world_cup AS DOUBLE)) AS col2

MATCH (p:Player)-[r:PlaysFor]->(t:Team)
MATCH (p)-[:ExtractedFrom]->(:Document)
MATCH (t)-[:ExtractedFrom]->(:Document)
WHERE r.tenure = 'latest'
  AND (
    CAST(p.nba_championships AS INT64) < 0
    OR CAST(REGEXP_EXTRACT(p.birth_date, '^(\\d+)', 1) AS INT64) < 1984
    OR (
      CAST(REGEXP_EXTRACT(p.birth_date, '^(\\d+)', 1) AS INT64) = 1984
      AND (
        CAST(REGEXP_EXTRACT(p.birth_date, '^\\d+/(\\d+)', 1) AS INT64) < 10
        OR (
          CAST(REGEXP_EXTRACT(p.birth_date, '^\\d+/(\\d+)', 1) AS INT64) = 10
          AND CAST(REGEXP_EXTRACT(p.birth_date, '^\\d+/\\d+/(\\d+)', 1) AS INT64) <= 14
        )
      )
    )
  )
RETURN t.team_name AS col1, AVG(CAST(p.fiba_world_cup AS DOUBLE)) AS col2
